 Compensation 
Compensation includes a base salary in the range of $74,000.00 - $111,000.00. The base salary may vary within the anticipated base pay range based on factors such as the ultimate location of the position and the selected candidate’s knowledge, skills, and abilities. Position may be eligible for additional compensation that may include an incentive program. 
 Job Description 








 The Software Engineer I builds automation and AI solutions for business functions across Cox Enterprises. Working with guidance from senior engineers, the role develops, tests and supports RPA, document processing and AI agent solutions on UiPath, Microsoft Power Platform & Copilot Studio and Claude. The Agentic AI & Automation team delivers automations and AI solutions across the Cox Enterprises family of businesses. Engineers build to the analyst's solution definition and own automated testing as part of the definition of done.

 What You'll Do: 
 With guidance, build automations and AI agent solutions from the analyst's solution definition, business rules and exception logic.
 Integrate solutions with enterprise applications through REST APIs and connectors.
 Build in exception handling, retry logic, logging and human-in-the-loop review, following secure coding practices.
 Write and run automated unit and system tests to cover common code paths, using AI to generate test scripts from the solution definition.
 Run performance tests, and resolve issues found in testing and user acceptance testing.
 Identify manual tasks in the team's own work and automate them.
 Evaluate and respond to bug submissions on existing automations.
 Document solutions with design documents, release notes and runbooks.
 Support solutions through hypercare and handoff to the support team.
 Learn and apply industry and Cox engineering standards, and assist with special projects as assigned.
 
 Operating Model and Partnerships 
 Member of one of two delivery teams on the Agentic AI & Automation release train.
 Works with analysts, who define the business rules and expected behavior, and Product Owners, who write stories and accept the increment.
 Participate in code reviews with internal and support engineers, and in user acceptance testing with customers and stakeholders.
 Hands solutions to the support team with documentation and tested exception handling.
 
 
 Who You Are: 
 Qualifications 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or a related field and up to 2 years' experience; or 4+ years' experience in lieu of a degree.
 6+ months experience with UiPath (Studio, Orchestrator) or another RPA platform
 Proficiency in at least one programming language (Python, C#, VB.NET, JavaScript or TypeScript) and working knowledge of SQL.
 Understanding of version control (Git), testing, debugging and Agile delivery.
 Clear written and verbal communication.
 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 UiPath certification.
 Experience building with large language models or agent frameworks (Copilot Studio, Claude or similar), including prompt design and API integration.
 Intelligent document processing and integration with enterprise systems such as ServiceNow or SharePoint.
 Internship, co-op or project experience delivering automation or AI solutions to business users.
 
 Benefits 







The Company offers eligible employees the flexibility to take as much vacation with pay as they deem consistent with their duties, the company’s needs, and its obligations; seven paid holidays throughout the calendar year; and up to 160 hours of paid wellness annually for their own wellness or that of family members. Employees are also eligible for additional paid time off in the form of bereavement leave, time off to vote, jury duty leave, volunteer time off, military leave, and parental leave. 
 About Us 







As our primary divisions Cox Automotive and Cox Communications drive new waves of innovation, Cox Enterprises is entering spaces like cleantech, healthcare, esports and more. We're a family business guided by a legacy of bold innovation that’s driven by those who want to make their mark. Benefits of working at Cox may include health care insurance (medical, dental, vision), retirement planning (401(k)), and paid days off (sick leave, parental leave, flexible vacation/wellness days, and/or PTO). For more details on what benefits you may be offered, visit our benefits page. Cox is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer – All qualified applicants/employees will receive consideration for employment without regard to that individual’s age, race, color, religion or creed, national origin or ancestry, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, physical or mental disability, veteran status, genetic information, ethnicity, citizenship, or any other characteristic protected by law. Cox provides reasonable accommodations when requested by a qualified applicant or employee with disability, unless such accommodations would cause an undue hardship.  
  
 
 
Applicants must currently be authorized to work in the United States for any employer without current or future sponsorship. No OPT, CPT, STEM/OPT or visa sponsorship now or in future.
